## Checklist

- [ ] **Clean-room:** This change is original. It does not copy, port, translate, or closely paraphrase code, CSS, docs, or API designs from other libraries, tutorials, or Q&A sites. Public concepts only, implemented independently. See `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `NOTICE`.
- [ ] **Accessibility:** Keyboard use, focus visibility, names/roles/states, and contrast are considered. Motion/transparency/contrast preferences are respected where this change touches UI.
- [ ] **Tests:** Behavior changes include tests in the same change (or this PR is docs/config only).
- [ ] **Commits:** Signed with `-sS`; Conventional Commit messages; no AI/tool co-author trailers.
